To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the impact of secondary notation on model understanding is stronger for novice than expert process model readers, and that this effect is stronger for novice readers when they are confronted with more complex models.

the more a model is perceived as a whole, the more the model is understood; the less the model is perceived as an object, the more the process model is understood; and the more a model’s layout is perceived as a pattern, the more the business process model is understood.

the more experienced readers of process models tend to prefer a layout that is less complex, i.e., with less crossing edges, and that is closer to the natural reading direction, i.e., from left to right.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the following questions: How do the graphical layout and the secondary notation affect the comprehension of process models?
the following questions: How does the layout of a process model affect the understanding of this model?
the following questions: What is the impact of the secondary notation on understanding process models?
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
secondary notation has an effect on the comprehension of process models.
the layout and the secondary notation of a business process model are not only important, but they can also be used to enhance process model understanding.
the secondary notation of process models does not affect comprehension, but only the comprehension of experts, and that this effect is only significant in case of complex processes.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the layout of process models can be an important aspect in understanding them, and it should not be ignored when creating and presenting models.
the secondary notation has a significant impact on process model understanding and that the impact is mediated by expertise.
we propose to study the effect of secondary notation on model understanding, which is a new topic in the BPM field.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the secondary notation is an important factor in understanding process models.
layout is an important aspect of business process models, and it should not be neglected when creating and presenting models.
layout is not just a by-product of the modeling process.
